subject: [PATCH v2] btrfs: flush the fixup workers during close_ctree

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the comment in close_ctree() about flushing fixup workers is not sufficient, as it does not guarantee that all pending work will be completed before umount.

reviews.author: David Sterba
reviews.summary: Reviewer David Sterba noted that the patch is not stable and suggested splitting it into a separate commit from the existing large fixup worker commit.
reviews.raw_body:
BTW the commit is not stable, so you can only use the subject for
reference.

As the new fixup worker commit is already big, please add this one
separately.

2026-07-31.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in Btrfs where fixup workers can still be running when the fs roots are freed during unmount, leading to memory allocation errors and potential crashes. To solve this, the patch adds explicit flushing of the fixup workqueue before unmount, and also denies new fixup queueing during umount. This ensures that all fixup writeback is completed before declaring BTRFS_FS_STATE_NO_DELAYED_IPUT.
